_comment: Copy to mcp_servers.json and start speech-to-speech with --mcp_config <path>. Secrets come from the environment or a .env next to this file (see .env.example). Only tools listed under 'tools' are exposed to the model. kind=write tools need a spoken 'yes' before they run. Full reference: docs/mcp-tools.md

get_events.description: List events on the user's Google Calendar. Omit time_min for 'from now'. Use time_min/time_max (RFC3339) for a specific day or range, and query to search by keyword.

search_gmail_messages.description: Search the user's Gmail using Gmail search syntax, e.g. 'is:unread', 'from:alice newer_than:2d', 'subject:invoice'. Returns sender, subject and date of the newest matches.

manage_event.description: Add an event to the user's Google Calendar. start_time and end_time are RFC3339 with the local offset; default to one hour long if the user gives no end.

find-tasks-by-date.description: List the user's Todoist tasks due on a date. Defaults to today including overdue. startDate is YYYY-MM-DD or 'today'; daysCount covers several days.

add-tasks.description: Add one task to the user's Todoist inbox.

content.description: Short task title, e.g. 'Call the dentist'.

dueString.description: Due date in natural language, e.g. 'tomorrow at 5pm', 'every Monday'.

priority.description: p1 is highest. Omit for normal.
